newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 614c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 614c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market's eastern indicator remained steady on 614 cents a kg clean at auctions in Sydney and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In merino fleece, the 19 micron indicator was 1.5 percent dearer, while 20/22/25m were 0.5 percent cheaper.
The 21m class was 0.5 percent dearer, 23m 1.0 percent cheaper and 24m unchanged, it said.
In merino skirtings, 18.5m and finer were 2.0 percent dearer while 19m was up to 1.0 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 26m was 0.5 percent dearer, 27/28m were up to 1.0 percent cheaper, 29m was unchanged and 30/31m slightly cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were firm, locks up to 2.0 percent dearer and crutchings generally unchanged.
Japanese interests and Western Europe provided principal competition with good support from most trade sectors, WI said.
Of the 24,826 bales offered, 10.3 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Thursday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 23,000 bales on offer.
